mapper.sql: id, session_id, user_id, title, message_count, last_message_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_message_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (session_id, user_id, title, message_count, last_message_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_session SET message_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}), last_message_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
